text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus was unable to hide her 
nervousness ahead of her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono gave her a boost of 
encouragement. With a supportive message 
from an action actor as well, Biko 
Pegasus's tension began to melt away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, her friends from the sprint 
division showed up to cheer. Biko Pegasus 
found herself brimming with motivation.
